report_text:
Prototype pollution in chalk 5.3.0's hex() colour helper.

    When a colour string containing '__proto__' segments is passed to the
    hex() helper, the style cache merges the parsed value into a shared
    object without filtering prototype keys. Any application that builds
    colour strings from user input (theming endpoints) will have
    Object.prototype polluted, leading to privilege escalation in
    downstream authorization checks.

    Expected effect: calling chalk.hex() with the crafted colour string
    defines properties on Object.prototype in the same process. Fixed
    supposedly in 5.3.1; we have not verified.
